Two stoners from Miami, a $300 million Pentagon contract, and an arms deal that spirals completely out of control. This is the incredible true story of David Packouz and Efraim Diveroli and their rise to become two of America’s most notorious arms dealers.

Special thanks to David Packouz and Guy Lawson for sharing their valuable insights with us.

Key sources for this video include Guy Lawson’s book “War Dogs: The True Story of How Three Stoners From Miami Beach Became the Most Unlikely Gunrunners in History” and Efraim Diveroli’s autobiography “Once a Gun Runner”.
